title: Archmage Gorraferg ring
summary: Survive the grimling waves to draw out Archmage Gorraferg.
overview: Survive the grimling waves to draw out Archmage Gorraferg.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Assemble before triggering the ring; the controller advances through eight wave stages.
Pick up new grimlings promptly and keep the fighting area clear for the next wave.
The last stage calls the archmage after a short delay. Save resources for that final opponent.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
